scientific_integrity: All-length theorem has an elementary degree lower bound and constructive Eulerian proof; finite checker is corroborative, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one circular, strictly class-alternating host and both window starting classes; arbitrary finite disjoint nonempty alphabets; no count of all optimum hosts and no linear-host optimum. Literature completeness is not proved.
title: Sharp cyclic covering length for class-alternating words
